'''An [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]]''' was plugged into the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] "[[Rookie One]]" used to escape from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-overrun [[Gamma Base]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] pilot subsequently employed this droid in the escort of a [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] fleeing [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]],<ref name="Sega CD">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]'' manual ([[Wikipedia:Sega CD|Sega CD]])</ref> as well as in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Rebel Assault">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]''</ref>
